meta.name: frontend
meta.description: MUST USE for frontend/web UI/UX/visual work: building, styling, redesigning pages/components, React setup, performance audits, visual QA, taste, and polish. Routes four rulesets: design taste router and brand references; perfection for Playwright/Chromium Lighthouse/Core Web Vitals; ui-ux-db palettes/fonts/guidelines; designpowers personas/accessibility/critique/handoff; plus curl-only lazyweb real-app-screen research and the beui.dev interaction catalog. Triggers: frontend, UI, UX, design, redesign, styling, layout, animation, motion, interaction, micro-interaction, make it feel alive, premium, luxury, minimal, brutalist, Awwwards, DESIGN.md, mockup, React, Lighthouse, accessibility, WCAG, Core Web Vitals, looks generic, make it pretty, like X brand, lazyweb, design research.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要构建美观且高性能的前端界面

howto.what: Claude会按任务加载对应设计参考与规则集,再创建或修改页面/组件,并用真实浏览器做性能与视觉验收。
howto.when: 当用户请求涉及前端/Web UI/UX/视觉工作,或说出“frontend”“UI”“design”等关键词时触发;也包括性能审计、视觉QA等场景。

say.text: 重新设计这个页面,参考 Stripe 的视觉风格。
say.note: 会加载品牌参考,提取设计令牌并改版。

say.text: 用 Lighthouse 审计当前项目,要求各项评分 100。
say.note: 会用真实浏览器跑审计并给出报告。

say.text: 按这张截图实现前端代码,并抽取设计规范。
say.note: 会走图片转代码流程生成组件。

howto.what_en: Claude loads the relevant design references and rulesets based on the task, then creates or modifies pages/components, and uses a real browser for performance and visual acceptance.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user requests frontend/Web UI/UX/visual work, or mentions keywords such as 'frontend', 'UI', 'design'; also for performance audits, visual QA, etc.

say_en.text: Redesign this page referencing Stripe's visual style.
say_en.note: Loads the brand reference and extracts design tokens.

say_en.text: Run a Lighthouse audit on this project and require 100 scores everywhere.
say_en.note: Runs a real-browser audit and produces a report.

say_en.text: Implement frontend code from this screenshot and extract the design spec.
say_en.note: Uses the image-to-code workflow to generate components.
